articles.title: 23 dead as minibus collides with trailer truck near Assam's Kaziranga
articles.summary: A tragic collision near Kaziranga has left a profound impact on the community, as a mini-bus carrying around 40 passengers crashed into a trailer truck on National Highway 715. The toll has risen to 23 fatalities, which includes several college students, with numerous others suffering injuries. In response, Assam's Chief Minister and state ministers have arrived to manage the relief efforts.

More than 17 hours after the outage began on November 12, some users may still face intermittent issues, and there is no timeline for full restoration.

Analysts point to rising hawkish attitudes in Washington, with Chinese tech stocks already sliding as the fallout from this scandal unfolds, highlighting the fragile nature of U.S.-China economic ties.

articles.title: WWII veteran, 101, recalls wife who helped him rebuild life, 72-year marriage

They raised four children together, creating a rich tapestry of community involvement and travel.

articles.title: Tissue paper with ‘Boom 1.50pm’ message sparks bomb scare on Chennai-bound IndiGo flight

Upon finding the note, the vigilant crew promptly alerted the pilot, who then sought a priority landing at Chennai airport. Enhanced security protocols were enacted upon arrival, leading to comprehensive inspections.

articles.title: IAF to hold week-long aerial wargames near the LAC

It is scheduled to run from November 13 to 21, focusing on operations near the Line of Actual Control. Aircraft including Sukhoi-30MKI and Mirage-2000, along with transport aircraft, will participate in the drills. The exercises aim to enhance operational readiness in challenging high-altitude environments and validate military concepts.

articles.title: NY father keeps custody after children spend school year with grandparents

The court scrutinized her sobriety and domestic violence allegations, leading to an ongoing custody dispute with more petitions yet to come.

articles.title: Darth Vader's lightsaber from iconic Star Wars duel sells for record $4.875m

The lightsaber surpassed previous auction records for both props and poster art. The auction featured the largest collection of Star Wars lightsabers ever offered, including twenty-seven other pieces. articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan add historic Irish castle to portfolio

Evidence suggests that Madhusudhan assaulted Upendra while Anita helped to suffocate him.

As hope diminishes, communities are left to grapple with a bleak future.

280 Ice Age engravings found in Spanish cave overlooked for 60 years
articles.summary: A remarkable archaeological find at Cova de la Font Major has revealed 280 Palaeolithic engravings, showcasing diverse motifs of animals and geometric shapes. This challenges the previously held notion that cave art was scarce in northeastern Iberia, where only two pieces were known. These engravings suggest the existence of unique artistic traditions independent of the famous Franco-Cantabrian region, offering new insights into the cultural practices of Ice Age Europe.
